Pothos is the easiest houseplant to propagate. Cut a vine just below a node, the small bump where a leaf and an aerial root emerge, keeping two or three leaves per cutting. Put the cuttings in a glass of water in bright indirect light and change the water weekly; roots appear within two weeks. Once the roots are a few centimetres long, plant them in a light, well-draining mix and keep it slightly moist while they adjust. Avoid the soggy soil described in [[Overwatering and root rot]].
